system.description:
Under certain triggers, the character enters an uncontrollable rage, attacking anyone nearby until calmed.

  • Rank 1: Initiating the Blind Fury is difficult; reverting to a normal emotional state is easy
  • Rank 2: Initiating the Blind Fury and reverting to a normal emotional state are both moderately difficult
  • Rank 3: Initiating the Blind Fury is easy; reverting to a normal emotional state is difficult
